acceptance: A vitest test passes for five inputs: 5000ms gives "just now", 12000ms gives "12s ago", 300000ms gives "5m ago", 7200000ms gives "2h ago", and 259200000ms (3 days) gives "3d ago".

properties.name: reads just now for anything under ten seconds or not finite
properties.criterion: 5000ms gives "just now"; negative and non-finite values read "just now" too.

properties.name: reads one whole unit and ago from ten seconds on, never a minus sign or NaN
properties.criterion: 12000ms gives "12s ago", 300000ms gives "5m ago", 7200000ms gives "2h ago" and 259200000ms gives "3d ago".

properties.name: rounds the unit down: its count fits and one more would overshoot
properties.criterion: The largest whole unit is rounded down, so 12s, 5m, 2h and 3d are the counts the inputs give.

properties.name: switches from seconds to minutes exactly at one minute
properties.criterion: Under a minute reads seconds ("12s ago"); a whole minute reads "1m ago".

properties.name: switches from minutes to hours exactly at one hour
properties.criterion: Under an hour reads minutes ("5m ago"); a whole hour reads "1h ago".

properties.name: switches from hours to days exactly at one day
properties.criterion: Under a day reads hours ("2h ago"); a whole day reads "1d ago".

properties.name: reads an ISO timestamp as the span from now, so the subtraction cannot flip
properties.criterion: The pull request card's opened time is the span from now to the artifact's timestamp, giving the same label formatAgo gives for that span.
